description: Acterys Variance is a dynamic Power BI variance visual that combines powerful KPI tracking, forecasting, and real-time planning in one intuitive solution. Built for FP&A professionals and analysts, this custom Power BI visual for variance analysis enables teams to explore financial data, simulate scenarios, and drive strategy—all without leaving the Power BI environment. From interactive KPI cards in Power BI to drag-and-drop forecasting, Acterys Variance helps businesses monitor key metrics, adjust plans in real time, and visualize variances using IBCS-compliant formats. It’s designed for organizations seeking a comprehensive, visual-first approach to scenario planning and performance tracking in Power BI. Key Features: Customizable KPI Cards: Choose between absolute values, percentages, or waterfall charts to tailor how each metric is displayed. Drag-and-Drop Planning: Instantly adjust data points in the visual to reflect different planning outcomes and simulations. Cut-Off Period Configuration: Forecast accurately by setting fixed periods to measure projected impact over time. Multiple Display Modes: Arrange cards in grid or list format using small multiples for efficient comparison across scenarios.
